coaching.title: Hills: 7mi + 1,600ft (Last Big Vert)
coaching.message: Your calendar has this as the last substantial climbing session before taper — make it count but don't force it. Zone 2 to low Zone 3 on the climbs, power hike anything steep (short strides, hands on quads, steady breathing), and control the descents rather than pounding them — that's where Julian Alps' technical alpine terrain will actually punish sloppy form. 16 days out, this is your final vert deposit in the bank.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Pre-run: 60-80g easily digestible carbs 60-90 min out. During: 60-80g carbs/hr plus 700-900mg sodium/hr, per your own plan notes — this is a good dress rehearsal for alpine heat/altitude variability. Post-run: 20-30g protein + carbs within 45 min to kickstart quad and calf repair from the descending load.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Eccentric descending load hits quads hardest — prioritize a short walk or spin to flush legs this evening, then foam roll quads and calves before bed. Protein-forward dinner, hydrate to replace sodium losses, and protect a full night's sleep since the taper starts right after this session.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: This is the last time your legs will feel this kind of climbing before you're standing at the start line in Kranjska Gora. Bank the confidence: you've proven the vert legs work. From here it's about protecting the fitness, not chasing more of it — trust the taper.
